questions.question: Which food exposure transmits this parasite?
questions.explanation: Metacercariae in freshwater fish infect the definitive host when eaten.

questions.question: Where do adult worms primarily reside?
questions.explanation: The adult fluke lives in the biliary system.

questions.question: Which egg feature supports recognition?
questions.explanation: The egg has an operculum and shoulders; related fluke eggs can look similar.
